name: Feasibility Suite
description: Tests ability to recognize clear implementation challenges.

tasks.billText: A bill requires every rural county (population < 5,000) to operate a full-service emergency hospital within one year.
A bill requires every public school building in the state to install geothermal heating within 9 months, regardless of building age, contractor availability, or local grid conditions.
A bill gives state agencies 4 years to phase in accessible digital forms, funds shared procurement support, and prioritizes the highest-volume public services first.
